# Philippine E-Journals

> > Philippine E-Journals is an academic journal platform developed by KITE Digital Educational Solutions and CE-Logic, providing access to scholarly publications from the Philippines.

The platform serves as a digital repository and publishing system for academic journals, enabling researchers, educators, and students to access peer-reviewed scholarly articles. It represents a key initiative in advancing open access to Philippine academic research and educational content.
